description: This file defines the KeyValueDAO class for managing key-value entries in a database, including methods for retrieving, creating, updating, deleting, and expiring entries, with integration to SQLAlchemy and custom error handling.

classes.name: KeyValueDAO
classes.description: Data Access Object class for key-value entries, providing static and class methods for CRUD operations and expiration handling.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieve a key-value entry based on resource and key.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Get the decoded value for a given resource and key, if not expired.

methods.name: delete_expired_entries
methods.description: Remove all expired entries for a given resource.

methods.name: create_entry
methods.description: Create a new key-value entry with encoded value and optional expiration.

methods.name: upsert_entry
methods.description: Update an existing entry or create a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: update_entry
methods.description: Update an existing entry with new value and expiration, or raise error if not found.
